description: Get a full calendar year of daily weather observations (temperature, precipitation, wind, pressure, sunshine, cloud cover) for a Meteostat weather station. Station ID comes from meteostat.stations_nearby. Data: Meteostat, aggregated from national weather services (CC BY 4.0), no auth required.

station_id.description: Meteostat weather station ID, obtained from meteostat.stations_nearby.

year.description: Calendar year to fetch daily observations for (e.g. 2024).

name: meteostat.observations.daily

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Daily Weather Observations
